main_text.p: tentia, sed ne quis me audaciæ incusat, nihil affirmo. Verùm فن تسلسل الكلام وخرجنا عن المقصود continuatio est orationis feries, & à proposito digressi sumus. ut revertamur, summa rei est, esse الفقه Al-phekho, Scientiam de rebus controversis, ac litibus quæ in exteriori hominum conversatione oriuntur, juxta Canones religionis Mohammedica dijudicandi, & الفقيه Alphakih, de his rebus sententiam ferendi peritum, cujus præcipuum studium sit حفظ القانون الذي يكف السلطان شر بعض اهل العدوان conservare canonem que avertat rex malum quod alius, bostilem animum gerens alii inferret, nec non de احكام الحلال والحرام licito & illicito, الجراحات والعدوان والغرامات [panarum infligendarum] quantitate, vulneribus & multis aliis ejusmodi quod ad externas actiones pronuntiare; quin & de Islamismo, seu religione ejusque conditionibus, quantum ad eam quæ ore fit, professionem. Siquidem quod ad cor خارج عن ولاية الفقيه ejus intentionem inquirere, non est الفقيه AlPhakih. Quid ergo erit الفقه quam juris (si ita loqui liceat) tam civilis quam Canonici apud eos peritia? cujus necessitas licèt sit (ut eâdem hîc similitudine utitur AlGazalius quâ de علم الكلام (seu Theologia Scholastica) non alia quàm quæ ὑποψιάζων ob latronum in via metum; prout tamen sunt hominum mores, eum obtinuit gradum ut {*}scientia nomen quasi sibi proprium vendicetv. AlGazal & Camus in [illegible, ~3 letters], nec alii facilè pro doctis habeantur, quàm qui rebus ejusmodi controversis dijudicandis operam oleúmque insumant.
P. 18.l. a:Ad quatuor reducuntur capita, &c.] Sic eorum, de quibus inter eos disputatur, statuit AlSharesta-nium

page.notes: Arabic and Greek words are copied as far as legible; the Arabic in the text, particularly the short words and vowel marks, is doubtful and should be checked against the scan. The Greek word after "ἑ" in the phrase "ob latronum" is uncertain and marked here as ὑποψιάζων. The left-margin note has a third line of Arabic that could not be read; it is marked illegible. The reference mark "*" before "scientia" is taken as the asterisk printed in the text, and the note beside it carries the same mark. The line ending "AlSharesta-" continues as "nium" on the next line; the reconstructed word "AlSharesta-nium" is doubtful. A small mark before "خارج" in the Arabic line could not be identified and is left out.
